description: Soil nematode sample records from the 2020 dataset. Each point marks the reported location of one sample.
format: packed binary, little-endian, no padding, one 13-byte record per sample in source-CSV row order

total_per_100g_dry_soil.units: nematode individuals per 100 g dry soil

biome_index.note: round(WWF_Biome) with the authors' Antarctica override applied (latitude < -60 deg forces code 25); UNFILTERED -- includes the two non-terrestrial codes (0, 98) that the biome_summary table below excludes. See biome_legend.

decode_note: 13 is not a multiple of 4, so records are NOT Float32Array-alignable across the whole buffer -- decode per-record with DataView (getFloat32/getUint8 at record_index*13 + field offset), not a strided typed-array view.

source.dataset_citation: Geisen, S., van den Hoogen, J., Data Providers, and Crowther, T. (2020). Nematode_abundance_dataset, version 1. Figshare.
source.citation: van den Hoogen, J. et al. A global database of soil nematode abundance and functional group composition. Scientific Data 7:103 (2020). doi:10.1038/s41597-020-0437-3
source.provenance_note: The full dataset item containing the source CSV carries the CC0 dedication. The collection DOI identifies its enclosing collection.

caveats: Point coordinates locate samples. Estimating the fraction of land sampled would require information on the area each sample covered.
Extraction methods differ in how many nematodes they recover. This affects measured abundance. Model predictions also have estimation error.
Sampling effort varies across biomes. The biome summary reports the number of sample records per included biome.

The 2019 study compiled 6,759 samples, aggregated them by pixel, and used 1,876 pixels for geospatial modelling after excluding 39 Antarctic pixels. This separate 2020 release contains 6,825 records. A biome code describes location and cannot establish whether an individual record contributed to the earlier model.
